notes.title: Version update
notes.notes:
Added node types in item creation, search multiple item nodes, health filter, energy filter, closest distance filter, percentage node, relational operator node
Search multiple item nodes: find all items within the radius excluding itself
Health filter: connect with the search multiple item node to filter multiple items, objects that meet the health percentage are left and the output is also 0 or more items
Energy filter: filter by comparing the energy values ​​of multiple objects, and output 0 or more objects that meet the conditions
Nearest distance filter: filter by distance, keep the items closest to the items and output 0 or 1 items
Percentage node: output a value of 1-100
Relational operator node: set >, <, =, >=, <=, ==, != and other relational operators
Item creation interface fine-tuning
Bug fixes
